prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: polished final-quality fullscreen UI ideal mockup for a Chinese cultivation game's medicinal-farm MANAGEMENT INTERFACE, 1920x1080 composition, wide 16:9. This is a UI design deliverable: style, typography, grid, spacing and information hierarchy must be excellent and readable.

CRITICAL VIEWPOINT: The central farmland is a TRUE DIRECTLY-OVERHEAD 90-DEGREE ORTHOGRAPHIC PLAN VIEW, like a carefully illustrated management map. Every rectangular field is aligned parallel to the screen edges. NO isometric view, NO oblique perspective, NO scenic landscape painting, NO horizon, NO sky, NO mountains receding into distance, NO side-facing buildings, NO playable or decorative characters. The management UI, not an illustration with a few buttons, is the subject.

VISUAL STYLE: refined Chinese ink-and-gouache game interface on pale warm rice paper, understated gray-green painted wood accents and thin dry-ink separators, dark readable Chinese text, soft muted sage-green selected states, warm tilled earth and desaturated leaf greens. Very subtle paper fiber texture. Crisp modern usable alignment with graceful Chinese serif/Kaiti typography, generous yet efficient spacing. Soft intermediate tones, excellent contrast. No bright gold, no neon, no glossy gradients, no big decorative scroll rods, no exaggerated torn-paper edges, no fancy fantasy borders. Use medium and regular weights, not tiny captions. Flat 2D game UI, not a physical book photographed or a monitor mockup.

LAYOUT:
- Slim full-width header, about 8 percent of height. Upper left large title exactly “药田”, next to small breadcrumb “玉虚仙宗 · 瑶圃峰”. Right side small date exactly “昭明历2371年1月2日”, and compact button “返回瑶圃峰”.
- Main body is a deliberately designed 3-column grid with consistent padding and aligned top edges. Left approximately 17 percent for crop catalogue; center approximately 60 percent for top-down farmland; right approximately 23 percent for selected-field information and operation. Keep center dominant and all three columns readable.
- Footer about 7 percent height, spanning the UI. Left a quiet short hint “单击选田，查看长势与操作”. Right a clearly grouped secondary button “取消选择” and action “批量管理”. No keyboard-debug hints or implementation prose.

LEFT COLUMN:
A small dark-ink brush heading or understated green-gray title strip exactly “种植目录”. Below, a compact row of tabs “全部” “草本” “苔藻”, with “全部” selected.
Four aligned generous catalogue ROWS, not giant cards: a small beautifully painted botanical thumbnail on left and readable crop name on right. Crop names exactly “雾铃花”, “月露苔”, “苦苔根”, “灵泉藻”. Select “雾铃花” with a restrained sage tint and slim side marker. Do not invent quantities, seed prices or availability labels.
Lower in this column put a quiet divider and section “田况筛选”, with clear small controls “全部田地”, “空田”, “生长中”, “可采收”. Keep these distinct from the crop catalogue. Healthy whitespace, no invented filler metrics.

CENTER COLUMN:
Title “田地总览” aligned with left and right headings. Under it, an expansive true TOP-DOWN FARM PLAN. The farm plan should look like real tilled soil beds, paths and rows of small plants seen directly from above, all on one continuous ground surface, rather than nine floating UI cards. Show a legible 3 by 3 arrangement of physical rectangular beds divided by narrow pale-earth walking strips. A narrow shallow irrigation channel runs along one edge. A little grass or small stones around the plan's perimeter provide restrained garden texture, but do not distract from UI.
The 9 beds are illustrative layout examples, NOT a formal gameplay capacity:
- 2 mature flower beds have dense rows of small white bell flowers and green leaves seen from overhead.
- 3 growing beds have neat rows of differently sized small green leaf rosettes.
- 3 empty tilled beds have clearly visible furrows, without plants.
- 1 corner bed is rough grassy undeveloped ground.
Plants must look like many actual small plants embedded in soil, not oversized inventory icons.
Put tiny tidy caption strips within or at the edge of each bed, consistent placement, with only necessary labels such as “空田”, “生长中”, “可采收”, “待开垦”. No progress bars covering the plants. Select the mature bed at middle-right with a single thin sage-green outline fitted to its exact field rectangle, small clear field label “东畦”. All beds remain fully visible when selected.
Once again, draw this CENTER MAP strictly as a plan, viewed straight down with zero perspective tilt. Rectangles are RECTANGLES, not trapezoids or diamonds. No raised planter-box front faces.

RIGHT COLUMN:
An actual well-designed compact information panel on pale opaque paper, title exactly “东畦”. A modest botanical illustration of white down-hanging bell flowers with narrow green leaves, alongside the crop name “雾铃花”. Small clean sage state badge “可采收”.
A thin separator, then aligned two-column information rows with labels left and values right:
“收获归属” — “个人”
“本轮收获” — “雾铃花 ×4”
“生长时长” — “24 小时”
Then a short quiet line “花已开，可以采收了。”
Main action button “采收”, in deep desaturated sage with pale text, comfortably sized. A secondary text action “查看物品”.
Keep the information dense enough to be useful without giant blank spaces, overly tall buttons, repeated cards or decorative stats. Botanical thumbnail stays secondary to the central farmland; it is NOT the main hero image.
No fictional soil stats, humidity gauges, fertility numbers, character attributes, yield bonuses, currency balances, shop prices or timers. Only the exact example values given above.

QUALITY CHECK: Must instantly read as a Chinese game UI for efficiently managing farmland: left catalogue, large central directly-overhead editable field plan, right inspector, footer management actions. Distinct mature, growing and empty fields. Crisp legible Chinese labels, clean grid and careful typography. Match the project's rice-paper/dark-ink/gray-green style. No characters, no mock physical frame, no editorial title outside the UI, no watermark, no captions saying prototype or sample inside the game screen.
